steps.label: Inner products
steps.sub: np.dot tells you whether two states are orthogonal

code:
H = (1/np.sqrt(2)) * np.array([[1,1],[1,-1]])

H * H
# [[0.5 0.5]
#  [0.5 0.5]]   just squares entries

H @ H
# [[1. 0.]
#  [0. 1.]]     real matrix product
caption: H @ H gives the identity — applying Hadamard twice does nothing; H is its own inverse.

eyebrow: Applying a gate to a state
caption: gate @ state is literally what "applying a gate" means in code.

code:
Y = np.array([[0,-1j],[1j,0]])

Y.conj().T
# [[0.-0.j 0.-1.j]
#  [0.+1.j 0.-0.j]]
# equals Y itself -- Y is Hermitian
caption: A matrix equal to its own conjugate transpose is Hermitian — every quantum observable has this property.
